IUMA.com Biography:
The Darwin Engine was established in 2000 by Matt Schaefer, drummer of the band Lift, as a musical outlet for his erratic and extreme thought patterns. the music of the Darwin Engine is very heavy and rhythmic, and the melodies contrast heavily between disturbingly dissonant and pleasantly uplifting. Matt is the only permanent member of the Darwin Engine

Wahomo is a new wave in Ukrainian music, blending authentic Ukrainian folklore with elements of progressive rock, post-rock, and psychedelia. Their music offers a powerful, heavy, and immersive experience that takes the listener deep into self-awareness.

The band was formed in 2018 by vocalist Lyubov Huk (Любов Гук) and Kyiv musician (guitar) Nikto Niktoev (Yevhen Poradun ? ).
